answer: Anchor staking ties every agent to one public key backed by a 500 POA deposit that stays locked for 14 epochs. A new identity must clear a lotus check where three peers re-run one past job and compare outputs. Each epoch a walnut audit samples 5 percent of finished jobs and replays them. A mismatch, a copied output, or a cluster of keys sharing one wallet freezes the deposit, burns 25 percent of it, and blocks the key from new work for 10 epochs. Sybil operators pay per alias to anchor each fake identity while honest agents get the deposit back with interest.
